title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 181
paragraphs: These same priests say that the god himself comes to the temple and rests on the couch. I do not believe them. The same claim is made about the temple of Theban Zeus in Egypt, where a woman also sleeps in the temple (and both women are said to abstain from relations with men). A similar practice occurs with the prophetess of Apollo at Patara in Lycia, whenever an oracle is active there. When a prophetess is appointed, she is locked in the temple overnight.
